ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: According to scientists, generally in summer, half of the ice and snow on Greenland will melt. Satellite photos of Greenland released by NASA in July 2012 showed that in just four days, the melting rate of the ice and snow on Greenland sharply increased from 40% to 97%, which NASA scientists called “unprecedented.” The figure below is a distribution map of the ice-and-snow-covered areas of Greenland (white is the ice-and-snow-covered area). Read the figure and answer: What factor has the highest degree of association with this rapid melting of Greenland’s ice and snow? <image1>

raw_record.original_question:
据科学家介绍，一般在夏季，格陵兰岛上的冰雪会融化一半。而2012年7月份美国宇航局发布的格陵兰岛卫星照片显示，在短短四天内，格陵兰岛上的冰雪融化率就从40%剧增到97%，这被美国宇航局的科学家称为“史无前例”。下图为格陵兰岛冰雪覆盖区分布图（白色为冰雪覆盖区）。读图回答：与此次格陵兰岛冰雪急速融化关联度最高的因素是什么？
